title: Notary part a: the retract verb as designed in T-406 (decision 4)
description: Build exactly the handoff list of .harness/design-T-406-retraction.md. The live retraction of the 2026-08-17 false verdict is T-460, not this task.
acceptance_criteria: RETRACT_KIND = 'retract' is unprivileged and needs no intent.
retract(root, name, key_path, target_seq, reason) signs an act whose body carries retracts (digest), retracts_seq and a non-empty reason; a blank reason is refused. The attest.py CLI exposes it.
retractions(root, name) maps digest to retracting act, computed on read; trace and verify_name consult it; chain renders it inline.

Tests: the refusals the design lists; backward resolution; the D-17 limit pinned by a stolen-key forgery of a retraction; PR-022 clause 4 pinned by an output-shape guard showing no counter, weight or gate reads the retraction fields; and the acceptance case replayed on a fixture chain in a temporary directory, never on the live registry.
Append-only: no act is removed or rewritten. Do not edit CLAUDE.md. The suite passes via goal_mode. Hand off to verifier.

notes.note: plan: add RETRACT_KIND + retract()/retractions() to attest.py, wire into trace/verify_name/chain CLI, add test_attest_retraction.py; fixture-only, no live acts touched

HANDOFF -> verifier: Built exactly the handoff list of .harness/design-T-406-retraction.md, part (a) only (T-460 owns the live retraction, not touched here).

WHAT CHANGED in .harness/bin/attest.py:
- RETRACT_KIND = "retract", NOT added to PRIVILEGED_KINDS (unprivileged, no intent), with a docstring stating the ACCEPTED D-17/DIS-2 limit verbatim.
- retract(root, name, key_path, target_seq, reason) -> signs a RETRACT_KIND act whose body carries retracts (target digest), retracts_seq, reason; blank reason refused before any file is written. Refusals: no act at that seq on the retractor's OWN chain (structural: no parameter can name a foreign act); target must verify under the retractor's own key; one retraction per target (second is refused, not a silent dup); a retraction cannot be retracted.
- retractions(root, name) -> {target_digest: retracting_act}, computed on read from name's own chain only, no side ledger (PR-010). First-in-chain-order wins if the sign-time refusal is ever bypassed by a direct file edit.
- trace(): rows gain retracted (bool) / retracted_by (seq); complete is untouched by retraction (a row can read complete:true, retracted:true); counts gain retracted_raw/retracted_distinct (raw+distinct, TELEMETRY-PROVENANCE-A); new note RETRACTION_DOES_NOT_CHANGE_COMPLETE.
- verify_name(): new "retracted" list (seq/digest/retracted_by_seq/reason); retracted acts are NOT counted as signature_failures.
- CLI: new `attest.py retract --name --key --seq --reason` subcommand; `attest.py chain --name X` now prints "RETRACTED by seq N" inline on the target act's line; `_render_trace` prints a retractados count line.
- PUBLIC_API extended with "retract", "retractions".
